verdict.rationale: Exa is API-first. Its main UI-visible products are all exposed through the API, SDKs and MCP: search, contents, answer, deep search, Exa Agent and Connect. Websets can be built either visually in the Dashboard or via the API, and results arrive through the dashboard, API or webhooks. A Team Management API also sits alongside the public API in the downloadable OpenAPI specs. missing for 10: no explicit statement of UI/API parity, no evidence that billing actions (adding credits, auto recharge, invoices) or per-key limit settings work via the API, and no independent hands-on confirmation of parity.
